decision_record.question: What is the exact X-Learner cross-fitting/OOF/combination design for T09, what LightGBM configuration governs the four nuisance fits and two effect fits, and what scale-gating path does the SMOKE workload need under D30?
evidence_considered: docs/05_methodology_scope.md X-Learner section: two-fold training-only cross-fitting; pseudo-outcomes D1 = Y - mu0_hat(X) (treated), D0 = mu1_hat(X) - Y (control); combination tau_hat(x) = g(x)*tau0_hat(x) + (1-g(x))*tau1_hat(x)

docs/01_causal_contract.md / docs/02_data_contract.md: no documented per-unit design assignment probability exists in this repo's frozen contracts, so g(x) falls back to the training-only empirical treatment rate -- a constant, not a covariate-varying estimate
D30: SMOKE -> [RESOURCE GATE(S) if required] -> FULL; resource_gates is a per-task judgment recorded before FULL

T07 FULL and T08 FULL already proved src/lightgbm_baseline.fit_binary_classifier at full scale with the identical frozen binary config; T09's four nuisance fits are each on a population smaller than either arm-specific T08 fit (half the training rows, further split by arm)

A binary LightGBM objective is invalid (not merely inappropriate) for a signed continuous pseudo-outcome target -- the effect stage requires a genuinely new (regression) primitive, added to src/lightgbm_baseline.py without altering the existing binary path

D1/D0 are never defined on validation rows (they require the opposite-fold OOF nuisance prediction plus the observed outcome, both training-only constructs), so the effect stage has no valid early-stopping target without inventing a new internal split the frozen contract doesn't require -- it therefore runs a fixed, predeclared EFFECT_NUM_BOOST_ROUND=100 with no early stopping

User correction (binding over the original CODE PLAN draft): every training row -- both arms -- must receive BOTH mu0_oof and mu1_oof from the opposite fold, not only the arm-relevant OOF surface. This stays at exactly four nuisance fits; it changes which existing predictions are assembled onto each row, not how many models are fit
decision_record.decision: SMOKE -> FULL. resource_gates = 0. smoke_size = 200000 total development rows (train+validation combined, joint-(T,Y)-stratified, seed 42), drawn with the same T07/T08 smoke_selection_rule; the SMOKE train subset is then split into two training-only folds via assign_folds() (joint-(T,Y)-stratified, fold_seed=42).
decision_record.why_resource_gates_zero: The binary-fit mechanism is already proven at full scale by T07 FULL/T08 FULL. Each of T09's four nuisance fits operates on a population smaller than any single T08 arm-fit (half the rows before arm-partitioning). The two new effect-stage regressions run a fixed 100 rounds with no early-stopping search and no validation-set scan, which is a lighter computational pattern than binary early stopping, not a heavier one. Six sequential fits instead of T08's two is additive wall-clock, not a new resource-risk category.
decision_record.why_fold_seed_fixed_across_robustness_se: Fold assignment is a data-partition property (which rows fall in Fold A vs Fold B), not a model-fit property, matching T05's precedent of a single frozen partition serving all downstream model seeds. Only the LightGBM `seed` in FROZEN_BINARY_CONFIG / FROZEN_REGRESSION_CONFIG varies across robustness passes (42 primary and required; per D33/AMENDED_BY_D29, 123/2026 are supporting, non-blocking evidence -- reported where computationally reasonable, not a precondition for FULL acceptance).
decision_record.smoke_purpose: Engineering/correctness rehearsal only -- proves the full six-model mechanism (4 nuisance fits, opposite-fold OOF assembly onto every row, D1/D0 construction, 2 effect fits, g-weighted combination) executes on genuinely non-degenerate data end to end, and that artifact/reload/hash mechanics work. SMOKE Qini/uplift numbers are mechanism evidence only and are not a performance estimate.

scale_gating.smoke_selection_rule: one deterministic joint-(T,Y)-stratified train_test_split draw per partition (train, validation), quota-proportional to the frozen train:validation split sizes, seed 42, identical rule to T07/T08; held-out never sampled or read; no model score or metric enters selection
scale_gating.fold_selection_rule: the resulting SMOKE train subset is split 50/50 into Fold A / Fold B via src.xlearner.assign_folds, joint-(T,Y)-stratified, fold_seed=42, training-only -- the SMOKE validation subset is never fold-split

xlearner_design.nuisance_early_stopping_target: arm-relevant subset of the frozen common validation cohort (same cohort as T07/T08), never the opposite fold and never held-out
xlearner_design.oof_assembly_rule: fold-uniform: every training row (both arms) receives mu0_oof and mu1_oof from the OPPOSITE fold's models, regardless of the row's own arm. Fold A rows: mu0_oof<-mu0_B(x), mu1_oof<-mu1_B(x). Fold B rows: mu0_oof<-mu0_A(x), mu1_oof<-mu1_A(x). No arm-selective application; no additional nuisance fits added to achieve this.

pseudo_outcomes.D1: Y - mu0_oof, defined on treated rows only
pseudo_outcomes.D0: mu1_oof - Y, defined on control rows only

xlearner_design.g_source: training-only empirical treatment rate (src.xlearner.empirical_treatment_rate), a fixed constant -- no documented per-unit design assignment probability exists in this repo's frozen contracts as of T09

lightgbm.tuning: none -- one predeclared binary configuration (reused unchanged from T07/T08) for all four nuisance surfaces, and one predeclared, fixed-round regression configuration for both effect surfaces

lightgbm_baseline_module.note: T09 adds fit_regressor/predict_values/FROZEN_REGRESSION_CONFIG/EFFECT_NUM_BOOST_ROUND alongside the unchanged T07/T08 binary path; the binary path's config/hash/behavior is asserted unchanged by tests/test_lightgbm_baseline.py::test_binary_config_and_hash_unchanged_by_regression_addition.

preprocessing.transform_fit_scope: LightGBMFeatureTransform (T04 v2, D32) fit ONCE on the full/smoke train partition for the effect stage (tau1/tau0), which has no cross-fitting boundary of its own. Continuous features (f0/f2/f7/f10) stay float64; categorical features (f1/f3/f4/f5/f6/f8/f9/f11) become the train-fitted pandas categorical representation LightGBM recognizes natively.

nuisance_stage_fold_local_correctness_re.reason: A prior implementation fit ONE LightGBMFeatureTransform on the whole train partition (both folds combined) and reused it for both folds' nuisance models -- this let each fold's categorical vocabulary be informed by the opposite (OOF) fold's own category values, and separately, converting the fitted frame to .to_numpy() and back to reconstruct fold/arm subsets silently dropped the pandas categorical dtype (would have raised lgb_baseline's own categorical-representation guard at fit time). Fixed as a correctness repair restoring the already-approved OOF fold-local fitting boundary (AGENTS.md Owner decision boundary; no new methodology decision) in kaggle/02_uplift_modeling.ipynb's T09 SMOKE and FULL sections: each fold's transform (transform_fold_a_t09 / transform_fold_b_t09, and the FULL-section equivalents) is now fit ONLY on that fold's own raw training-side rows. The opposite fold's OOF prediction, and that fold's own early-stopping validation set, are transformed using the SAME fitted transform the corresponding nuisance model was trained under -- never a transform fit on the rows being predicted. The two-fold cross-fitting scheme, joint-(T,Y) fold stratification, fold seed 42, and D0/D1 formulas are unchanged. The effect-stage transform (this field, fit once on the whole train partition) is unaffected -- it has no cross-fitting boundary to violate.

Per D32, f1/f3/f4/f5/f6/f8/f9/f11 are categorical tokens; that representation is STALE_FEATURE_REPRESENTATION. These immutable run artifacts are not modified or deleted, but cannot authorize a current T09 model and must not be cited as current evidence. D1=Y-mu0_oof, D0=mu1_oof-Y, the OOF/cross-fitting leakage boundary, and the final combination rule are all unaffected by this notice -- only the nuisance/effect base-learner feature representation must be recomputed against T04 v2 (LightGBMFeatureTransform) across all three model seeds.
